Delhi Police told Supreme Court they averted public order crisis

Delhi Police informed the Supreme Court that timely and lawful measures were taken to avert a major public order situation in the capital during a protest by the Centre for Public Interest Litigation (CJP). The police stated that these actions prevented a crisis.
